cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Hope Keeps Moving
cards.instruction: Turn every disappointment into a new reason the desired outcome is delayed, redirected, or becoming more meaningful.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The hall rejected our wedding booking. Apparently we're meant to marry somewhere less municipal. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Every venue is booked for June.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then September gives us three more months to practise being married.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My parents can't travel in September.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we go to them. Their garden! We're finally finding out where this wedding belongs.
